# Microsoft policy guide examples

XML snippets extracted on 2026-10-02 from the 13 requested Microsoft Learn
policy guides. Microsoft and contributors publish their sample code under
[MIT](https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/azure-docs/blob/main/LICENSE-CODE).
The Copilot guide source is in
[azure-management-docs](https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/azure-management-docs/blob/main/articles/copilot/author-api-management-policies.md).

[The inventory](../../../docs/policy-validation/inventory.json) records each
source URL, source date, source SHA256, code-block ordinal, source line, heading,
fixture SHA256, and any extraction adaptation. Only XML code is stored here;
documentation prose and screenshots are not reproduced. Source private addresses use loopback and concrete webhook/application URLs
use reserved placeholders. Every edit is explicitly recorded; the original
code-block hash still identifies the unmodified source specimen.

These are source specimens, not a claim that every block is an executable
policy document. Some are fragments, templates, contain `[...]`, or have
unescaped expression quotes or unclosed tags in the original documentation.
Tests that make a fragment executable must state their wrapper and markup
repairs. Real endpoint identifiers and credentials must come from test mocks
or environment inputs. Runtime evidence belongs to an explicit test or live
workflow result, separately from source extraction and parser registration.
